entry_points.summary: nested dict {host_name: {command_id: CommandTier}}; populated at adapter import time
registers per-host command tiers; raises ValueError if any KNOWN_COMMANDS entry is missing
O(1) lookup (host, command) -> CommandTier; returns 'blocked' for unknowns (fail-safe)
frozen dataclass of static per-host capability flags
re-export from runtime.drivers._export_utils; canonical import location for z_harness_cli callers
probes all five adapters, including OMP partial; returns (adapter, DetectResult) pairs in canonical order
resolves host with optional Rich picker; raises UnknownHostError / NoHostInstalledError
native-fidelity adapter; export_payload is persona-only (plugin reads skills/<id>/SKILL.md natively)
high-fidelity adapter; export_payload runs two-stage pipeline (runtime + persona loop)

flattened adapter; export_payload runs two-stage pipeline producing native .cursor/skills/<id>/SKILL.md files plus one generated always-apply .cursor/rules/z-harness-skills.mdc index and AGENT .mdc rules
first-class gate-driven adapter with flattened default; export_payload runs two-stage pipeline producing skills/<id>/SKILL.md, .codex-plugin/plugin.json, AGENTS.md, and persona prompts

Evidence-backed Codex capability contract emitted at ProbeResults.codex_capabilities: app/plugin multi-agent support, CLI-visible agent support, AskUser/gate support, event-frame support, and derived support_tier.

Single source of truth for OMP fidelity and command tiers (T009). PARITY_EVIDENCE maps command families to T008 test classes; omp_adapter_fidelity() returns 'native' when all entries resolve. Removing a T008 class immediately downgrades the corresponding family.
OMP host adapter (T009 complete); fidelity_tier and command tiers read from omp_parity_gate. fidelity_tier='native'; z-execute/z-consult/z-gate/z-panel are native; all others are degraded.

Emits .omp/config.yml plus OMP package/discovery layout under .omp/z-harness/; returns ExportResult(fidelity='native') after T009. Must not reuse pi export rewrites. .omp/config.yml is never modified.

Native OMP dispatch driver (T007): frozen argv/prompt-transport/event/session/model contract. Separate from scripts/omp-consult.sh. Rejects empty prompts; normalizes events; redacts secrets from telemetry.

native.description: Full orchestration + native personas. All /z-* commands run identically to the Claude Code reference. Multi-agent dispatch (subagents, panels, consults, gates) works natively.

partial.description: Adapter/export support implemented but parity not yet proven. Retained as a tier for future candidate hosts. OMP advanced from partial to native via T009.

high.description: Native skills/personas, single-agent only. Multi-agent commands (/z-execute, /z-panel, /z-consult, /z-gate) are degraded (single-agent transliteration, not blocked). All other /z-* commands run at native fidelity.

flattened.description: Transliterated rules, single-agent only. z-harness rules injected via host-native config file. Single-agent /z-* commands run in degraded mode. Multi-agent commands are blocked.

curated.description: Export-only. Curated rule/steering files with host-specific frontmatter (trigger for Windsurf, inclusion for Kiro). No adapter, no launch/inject. Export via runtime.drivers.<host>.export only.

pointer.description: Export-only. Single pointer/instructions file pointing to z-harness capabilities. No adapter, no launch/inject. Export via runtime.drivers.<host>.export only.

app_plugin_multi_agent_support.evidence_source: codex features list row for multi_agent
app_plugin_multi_agent_support.claim_boundary: App/plugin multi-agent evidence only; not proof that codex exec exposes CLI agent dispatch.

cli_visible_agent_support.evidence_source: codex exec --help agent/subagent flags or commands
cli_visible_agent_support.claim_boundary: Required before treating Codex CLI as a native subagent-dispatch candidate.

ask_user_gate_support.claim_boundary: Required before mapping z-harness gates onto Codex CLI.

event_frame_support.claim_boundary: Required before preserving native Codex event frames in the runtime driver.

codex_capability_contract.promotion_rule: support_tier summarizes probe evidence only. Command-family promotion still requires the relevant CLI fields plus parity-gate/runtime-driver evidence; app/plugin multi-agent support must not be conflated with Codex CLI support.

claude.stage1: none — native plugin reads skills/<id>/SKILL.md directly
claude.note: skills/ is the committed source; no export to files is needed or done on the native host

cursor.note: skills are written verbatim (no transliteration); z-harness-skills.mdc is the only generated always-apply .mdc index; AGENT rules use .cursor/rules/<id>.mdc; export artifacts are never committed

codex.note: skills written as native SKILL.md under export root; discovered by .codex-plugin/plugin.json 'skills' key; export artifacts are never committed

windsurf.structural_rule: all rule files require YAML frontmatter with 'trigger' key

kiro.structural_rule: all steering files require YAML frontmatter with 'inclusion' key

cline.structural_rule: single pointer file, plain markdown, non-empty body required

copilot.structural_rule: single instructions file, plain markdown, non-empty body required

omp.fidelity: native (T009); synchronized with OmpAdapter.fidelity_tier and COMMAND_CAPABILITY_MATRIX["omp"] via omp_parity_gate.py
omp.note: OMP export is implemented partial-fidelity first-class host support, not pi export and not omp-consult provider compatibility.

codex.mcp_note: Global/persistent write to ~/.codex/config.toml via runtime.drivers.codex.mcp.ensure_mcp_registered(); not reversed by ephemeral cleanup (F4)

capability_probe.adapter_tier_boundary: CodexAdapter.fidelity_tier is read from codex_parity_gate and remains flattened by default. Probe support_tier is evidence for later parity work and does not promote COMMAND_CAPABILITY_MATRIX by itself.
capability_probe.surface_split: app_plugin_multi_agent_support is distinct from cli_visible_agent_support, ask_user_gate_support, and event_frame_support.

windsurf.note: No HostAdapter, no adapter-registry entry, no launch/inject support. Export via runtime.drivers.windsurf.export only.
windsurf.structural_rule: trigger frontmatter key required on all rule files

kiro.note: No HostAdapter, no adapter-registry entry, no launch/inject support. Export via runtime.drivers.kiro.export only.
kiro.structural_rule: inclusion frontmatter key required on all steering files

cline.note: No HostAdapter, no adapter-registry entry, no launch/inject support. Export via runtime.drivers.cline.export only.
cline.structural_rule: single pointer file, plain markdown, non-empty body

copilot.note: No HostAdapter, no adapter-registry entry, no launch/inject support. Export via runtime.drivers.copilot.export only.
copilot.structural_rule: single instructions file, plain markdown, non-empty body

omp.config_injection: .omp/config.yml is never modified; z-harness writes only .omp/z-harness/session.yml (gitignored); discovery comes from OMP_PLUGIN_ROOT pointing at .omp/z-harness/
omp.dispatch_contract: native dispatch via OmpHostDriver (T007); frozen argv/event/session/model contract; consult-provider compatibility stays in scripts/omp-consult.sh (separate path, --no-rules --no-session)
omp.parity_gate: z_harness_cli/adapters/omp_parity_gate.py; PARITY_EVIDENCE keyed to T008 test classes; T009 resolved to native

pi.fidelity_tier: high export fidelity, export-only compatibility target
pi.note: No HostAdapter, no adapter-registry entry, no HostDriver, no launch/inject support. Export via direct import of runtime.drivers.pi.export.

command_tiers.note: Multi-agent commands are degraded on high-fidelity adapter hosts and blocked on flattened adapter hosts. Export-only hosts (pi/windsurf/kiro/cline/copilot) have no command-tier registration — they are not in the adapter registry. OMP command tiers (T009): z-execute/z-consult/z-gate/z-panel are native; all others are degraded. Tiers are driven by PARITY_EVIDENCE in omp_parity_gate.py — removing a T008 class downgrades the family. Codex CLI command tiers remain the adapter matrix result unless Codex capability probe fields and later parity evidence promote them.

per_tier.curated: export-only — no command tiers; not in adapter registry
per_tier.pointer: export-only — no command tiers; not in adapter registry

command_tiers.omp_note: OMP parity gate (T009) resolved: z-execute/z-consult/z-gate/z-panel are native (T008 evidence); all others are degraded. Adapter and export fidelity are both native. To promote a new family: add PARITY_EVIDENCE entry + T008 test class.

consult_provider_roles: native OMP command dispatch does not call scripts/omp-consult.sh

invariants: adapter fidelity_tier is stable per host except parity-gated hosts (OMP and Codex), whose adapter/export fidelity and command tiers are resolved through their parity gates
multi-agent commands (z-execute, z-panel, z-consult, z-gate) are degraded on high-tier hosts and blocked on flattened hosts
flattened = single-agent transliteration only; no subagent dispatch
high = native skill/persona loading via host-native mechanism; single-agent only; subagent dispatch absent
native = full orchestration including multi-agent subagent dispatch
cleanup_strategy=ephemeral for all four adapters in v1; MCP writes are global/persistent and NOT reversed by cleanup (F4)
ExportResult must be imported from z_harness_cli.adapters.base, not from runtime.drivers._export_utils directly (one-way layering)
ClaudeAdapter.export_payload is persona-only; Stage 1 runtime export is not run (native plugin reads skills/<id>/SKILL.md directly)
non-empty Stage-1 warnings raise RuntimeError immediately (legacy hard-gate; no silent downgrade)
persona-name collision with Stage-1 exported ids raises RuntimeError (MINOR-6)

windsurf/kiro/cline/copilot are export-only: no adapter module at z_harness_cli/adapters/<host>.py, no registry entry, no command tiers (M5 invariant — validated by TestAdapterAbsence in test_export_golden.py)

OMP parity gate (T009) resolved: OmpAdapter.fidelity_tier, OMP ExportResult.fidelity, and COMMAND_CAPABILITY_MATRIX["omp"] all read from omp_parity_gate.py; z-execute/z-consult/z-gate/z-panel are native; all others degraded.

Codex capability claims are evidence-backed by ProbeResults.codex_capabilities. App/plugin multi-agent support, CLI-visible agent support, AskUser/gate support, and event-frame support are separate fields; support_tier is only a summary and does not promote command tiers by itself.
Claude Code is the ground-truth parity target for OMP native behavior.
Native OMP execution must not call runtime/drivers/pi/export.py, pi prompt rewrites, scripts/pi_assets, or scripts/omp-consult.sh.
.omp/config.yml intentionally preserves skills.enableAgentsProject=false; native OMP discovery is explicit through OMP_PLUGIN_ROOT and the .omp/z-harness package.
pi is export-only even though its export result fidelity is high; it is not in the adapter registry and is not a native OMP stepping stone.
gotchas: codex is first-class but surface-split: the shipped Codex CLI adapter is flattened until parity evidence promotes it, while app/plugin multi-agent evidence is recorded separately by ProbeResults.codex_capabilities.app_plugin_multi_agent_support.

cursor and the Codex CLI adapter both declare fidelity=flattened but differ in MCP surface: cursor has supports_user_mcp=True, codex does not. Codex app/plugin probe evidence must not be substituted for CLI command parity.
antigravity uses ANTIGRAVITY_PLUGIN_ROOT; all three other adapters inject CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT
codex MCP registration is global (~/.codex/config.toml) and survives session cleanup; explicit removal only via z-harness doctor --clear-mcp
cursor needs_trust_prompt=True means inject() must not assume non-interactive; surface the prompt via PTY
canonical adapter order in registry remains claude > antigravity > cursor > codex > omp, but prod auto-selection is sorted by public_release_hosts(): claude, omp, codex
register_command_tiers() raises ValueError at import time if KNOWN_COMMANDS entry is missing — misconfigured adapters fail fast
antigravity collision domain is workflows/rules/skills stems (with z-harness- prefix stripped from rules); cursor uses .cursor/rules/ stems; codex uses prompts/ stems only (AGENTS.md excluded)
windsurf/kiro/cline/copilot are NOT adapters: registry.select(<host>) raises UnknownHostError for them; z_harness_cli/adapters/ has no module for them
Do not treat omp-gemini/omp-codex provider entries as native OMP host support; they are consult-provider compatibility through scripts/omp-consult.sh.
OMP command tiers start blocked/degraded until command-family evidence covers the matrix; a host-wide native label is forbidden before the parity gate.

dispatch.prompt_transport: final positional argv argument; do not rely on stdin in print mode
dispatch.empty_prompt: reject before spawn with a driver error
dispatch.output: assistant text to stdout result; stderr preserved separately; non-zero or empty required output becomes error with exit code and bounded stderr summary
dispatch.secret_rule: payloads enumerate fields explicitly and never log full env/config dumps, OAuth tokens, or raw model credential material
dispatch.session_rules_profile_model: native mode keeps rules enabled through OMP_PLUGIN_ROOT, preserves requested sessions, passes profile/model explicitly, and redacts those values from telemetry; consult mode is the only --no-rules --no-session path

discovery_export_layout.config_outcome: .omp/config.yml keeps skills.enableAgentsProject: false to avoid auto-loading the large root AGENTS.md; native discovery is explicit via package root

boundaries.legacy_pi_export: do not call runtime/drivers/pi/export.py, pi prompt rewrites, scripts/pi_assets, or vendored pi subagent extension
boundaries.omp_consult: scripts/omp-consult.sh remains provider-registry compatibility only and intentionally uses --no-rules --no-session

pi.note: No HostAdapter, no HostDriver, no --host pi, no launch/inject; not evidence for OMP native parity.

drift_verification.command: source review of z_harness_cli/adapters/registry.py, z_harness_cli/adapters/omp.py, runtime/drivers/omp/export.py, and runtime/drivers/codex/probe.py
drift_verification.conclusion: OMP parity gate (T009) resolved: OmpAdapter.fidelity_tier='native', OMP ExportResult.fidelity='native'; z-execute/z-consult/z-gate/z-panel are native; all other families degraded. Three OMP surfaces synchronized via omp_parity_gate.py. Codex now has a probe-backed codex_capabilities contract that distinguishes app/plugin multi-agent support from Codex CLI agent, AskUser/gate, and event-frame evidence.
